source_message.speaker: freelancer
source_message.text:
Project Timeline - Six weeks
Milestone - 1350 USD

The second milestone covers:
1\. Complete the Meet Alfred set up
2\. Create and configure a Zapier account
3\. Using Zap, connect Hubspot with Meet Alfred
4\. Create a Domain, then Warm it up
5\. Configure an automated LinkedIn Campaign in Meet Alfred
6\. Configure an automated Email Campaign in Meet Alfred
7\. Map the data flow running from Meet Alfred to Hubspot
8\. Build a Lead Management System in Hubspot
9\. Produce different types of reporting

routing_warnings.description: The reference to an already completed LinkedIn integration does not specifically establish automated LinkedIn campaign execution.
The message defines the HubSpot lead-status result of a LinkedIn connection acceptance.
The observed limitation concerns provisioning a new MeetAlfred campaign, not executing an automated LinkedIn campaign.
The failure concerns HubSpot leads not appearing in MeetAlfred.
The test verifies synchronization for newly added leads while identifying failure for leads predating the Zap.
Campaign launch follows the new-campaign setup exchange but does not explicitly verify automated LinkedIn execution.
The client proposes MeetAlfred automation for a later outbound campaign, which belongs to the independently inventoried outbound-execution Requirement.
The freelancer's preference for manual execution concerns the later outbound campaign.
The distinction between automated network growth and manual appointment conversations constrains the later outbound campaign.
